page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening is not text; this is the single text page). One text column in the centre with verse set in italic lines below the prose; a narrow strip of show-through text at the right edge (ignored). No notes in a margin of this page's text block.

main_text.p: nam in partem accipietis, qui-qui de sideribus ita mugina-mini : Videor mihi Phœbum (sic enim sol inter polyony-mos illos vocari mavult) quotidiani operis & pensi sui difficultates, Phaëtonti suo inculcantem audire :

page.notes: Catchword "Nefe-" printed at the right below the last line, here given as the final word of the text; the verse lines are set in italic type, with "Nefe-" in the same line-end position. Some words are doubtful in the scan, notably "Eniituntur" (probably Eniituntur/Enituntur) and "trepidet"; the printed forms are copied as they appear. Right edge shows show-through from the facing page, not transcribed.
